dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible as multiple high-contrast 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters. Three prominent rings at the dorsal-center display fuzzy light-colored edges that transition from the dark background into dark interior cores. One elongated 'O' shape at the top-right displays a nearly continuous, high-intensity perimeter.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high concentration of irregular, light-colored pixel clusters is present along the lower-lateral boundary. These clusters lack internal gradients and form a dense, mottled band of high-intensity pixels near the ventral transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most dorsal circular annuli form an obtuse triangle. A secondary geometric relationship is formed by the longitudinal alignment of the two dorsal-right annuli with the primary high-intensity cluster located near the flipper insertion.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible foreflipper displays five distinct, high-contrast, light-colored linear structures corresponding to claw tips, exhibiting sharp distal points against the dark flipper tissue.
